entries.sense_en: sent to work for a skilled worker in order to learn his trade

synonyms.nuance: General word for learning or teaching skills; says nothing about living and working under a master.
Modern, office or hospital setting, usually short and often unpaid; apprentice suggests a trade and years of service.
synonyms.example: He interned at a law firm.

synonyms.nuance: Old legal word: bound by a written contract to serve someone for a fixed time.

entries.tip_ko: be apprenticed to + 사람: '~ 밑에서 도제살이를 하다'. 수동태로 자주 쓰입니다.

entries.sense_en: the metal point of a pen that touches the paper

synonyms.nuance: Any pointed end of anything; nib is only the writing point of a pen.
Plain everyday word; less specific than nib.
synonyms.example: a pen with a fine point

entries.sense_en: crushed so that it is full of creases and folds

synonyms.nuance: Small lines on a surface; less violent than crumple, used for skin and cloth too.
A single neat fold line, often on purpose; crumple is messy and all over.
synonyms.example: Crease the paper down the middle.

synonyms.nuance: Pressing with force so the shape is destroyed; crumple is mainly for paper and cloth.

entries.sense_en: looked quickly and secretly, hoping no one would notice

synonyms.nuance: A quick look, but not necessarily secret; 'steal' adds hiding it.
A quick look at something hidden or not allowed, often playful.
Look through a small opening or quickly and secretly; a bit old-fashioned.

entries.tip_ko: steal은 여기서 '훔치다'가 아니라 '몰래 ~하다'. steal a kiss(몰래 입맞추다)도 같은 쓰임입니다.

entries.sense_en: let out a long, deep, shaky sigh

synonyms.nuance: The plain verb; heave a sigh makes it heavier and more effortful.
A low sound of pain or complaint, voiced; a sigh is mostly breath.

entries.tip_ko: broken sigh는 '부서진'이 아니라 흐느낌이 섞여 끊기는 한숨을 말합니다.

entries.sense_en: a holy picture of Christ or a saint, as in Russian homes

synonyms.nuance: General word for a picture; icon is a religious painting of a particular style.
A painting of a real person, not a sacred object for prayer.

entries.tip_ko: ikon은 옛 철자. 오늘날 icon은 컴퓨터 '아이콘'이나 '우상'의 뜻으로 더 자주 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: a wooden model of a foot on which a shoemaker shapes shoes

synonyms.nuance: Any hollow or solid shape used to form something; last is only for shoes.
A shaped block put inside a finished boot to keep its shape, not for making it.
synonyms.example: He kept his boots on boot-trees.

entries.tip_ko: 형용사 last(마지막)와 철자가 같지만 전혀 다른 명사입니다. 17문단에도 hit me on the head with a last로 나옵니다.

entries.sense_en: quick and light in movement

synonyms.nuance: Very close; agile sounds more athletic and is common in sports and business.
Used especially for old people who are still active.
Plain word for speed; nimble adds lightness and skill.
synonyms.example: He was quick on his feet.

entries.sense_en: large and roomy, more than big enough

synonyms.nuance: Pronoun or noun, not placed before a noun like ample.
Everyday word for clothes or spaces with lots of room inside.
Existing in large amounts; used for supplies, not for the size of a coat.

entries.sense_en: a small hammer with a wooden head

synonyms.nuance: Usually has a metal head for driving nails; mallet is softer, often wooden.
The small wooden hammer a judge or chairman uses.

entries.tip_ko: 러시아 야경꾼은 순찰하며 나무망치로 두드려 자기가 깨어 있음을 알렸습니다.

entries.sense_en: a quiet, gentle manner that never argues or resists

synonyms.nuance: Having a modest opinion of yourself; a moral virtue, not about submitting.
synonyms.example: He accepted the prize with humility.

synonyms.nuance: Obeying others too easily; more negative than meekness.
synonyms.example: the submissiveness of a frightened dog

synonyms.nuance: Gentle and not harsh; used for people, weather and flavors.

entries.sense_en: sly and scheming; clever at hiding bad aims (an old, prejudiced use)

synonyms.nuance: Common word for clever at tricking people.
Using dishonest, indirect ways to get what you want; more serious.

entries.tip_ko: 예수회(Jesuit)를 비꼬던 옛 표현으로 지금은 잘 쓰지 않고, 쓰면 편견이 담긴 말로 들립니다.

entries.sense_en: cleverness used to trick or deceive others

synonyms.nuance: Very close, a little more informal.
Literary; clever dishonesty used to deceive.
Quick intelligence, usually positive and funny, not deceitful.

entries.sense_en: beaten very hard, again and again, as punishment

synonyms.nuance: The basic verb; thrash is harsher and suggests a long beating.
Beaten with a whip or stick specifically.
Hitting a child's bottom with an open hand; much milder.

entries.sense_en: came back to life or health after nearly dying

synonyms.nuance: Get well again; neutral and gradual.
Informal: become conscious again after fainting.
synonyms.example: He came round after a minute.

synonyms.nuance: Medical: bring someone back by emergency treatment.

entries.sense_en: narrowing his eyes tightly to see better

synonyms.nuance: Very close, one verb; also used for bright light.
Often shows suspicion or anger, not just effort to see.
synonyms.example: He narrowed his eyes at me.

entries.tip_ko: screw up에는 '망치다'라는 뜻도 있지만 screw up one's eyes/face는 '(눈·얼굴을) 찡그리다'입니다.

entries.sense_en: a quiet, low laugh

synonyms.nuance: A high, silly laugh, typical of children or nervous people.
A louder, gleeful laugh, like a chuckle with a snort.
A half-hidden, often mean laugh at someone.

entries.sense_en: raising his shoulders, here hunching up against the cold

synonyms.nuance: Bending the back and shoulders forward, often from cold or tiredness.
Curling up or crowding together for warmth.

entries.tip_ko: 보통 shrug는 '모르겠다'며 어깨를 으쓱하는 동작이지만, 여기서는 추워서 어깨를 움츠리는 모습입니다.

entries.sense_en: powdered tobacco that people sniff into the nose

synonyms.nuance: The general word for the plant and what is smoked or chewed.
The act of breathing in through the nose; snuff is the powder itself.

entries.tip_ko: a pinch of snuff: 코담배 한 자밤. pinch는 손가락으로 집는 소량입니다.

entries.sense_en: so much that it cannot be put into words

synonyms.nuance: Usually for bad things.
Everyday intensifier; less literary.

entries.sense_en: twists her head quickly from side to side

synonyms.nuance: Lighter and more playful movement.
Twisting because of discomfort or embarrassment.
synonyms.example: The child squirmed in his seat.

synonyms.nuance: Violent twisting, usually from pain.

entries.sense_en: white ice crystals that form on trees and grass on cold nights

synonyms.nuance: The general word; hoarfrost is the thick white feathery kind.
Technical or poetic: ice formed from freezing fog, very similar.

entries.sense_en: covered with many small shining points

synonyms.nuance: Shine with flashes of light; describes the light, not the covering.
Covered with many small objects, like jewels or stars.
Plain word: spread with small spots here and there.

entries.tip_ko: The Star-Spangled Banner(미국 국가 제목)의 spangled와 같은 말입니다.

entries.sense_en: a deep pile of snow blown together by the wind

synonyms.nuance: A long heap of snow, often along a road after plowing.
The amount of snow that falls; not a pile.

entries.sense_en: an angry scolding

synonyms.nuance: Neutral everyday word for angry words to a child.
Informal British, very close in meaning.
synonyms.example: I got a telling-off from my boss.

synonyms.nuance: Formal, often official.

entries.tip_ko: 오래된 영국 구어라 지금은 거의 쓰지 않습니다.

entries.sense_en: hit hard with a loud blow

synonyms.nuance: Hit with an open hand, making a sharp sound.
Hit with the flat of the hand, usually the face.
Informal, a very heavy blow.

entries.sense_en: a child, spoken of with dislike

synonyms.nuance: Neutral, informal word for a child.
Naughty child, but said with affection.

entries.tip_ko: brat은 모욕적인 말입니다. '버릇없는 아이'를 비하할 때 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: eat all of it quickly and greedily

synonyms.nuance: Eat very fast, like a hungry animal.
Eat eagerly and completely; also used for reading books.

entries.sense_en: pushed suddenly and roughly

synonyms.nuance: Push roughly, usually a person or object out of the way.
Neutral; thrust is sudden and forceful.
Informal: put something quickly somewhere.

entries.tip_ko: thrust는 과거·과거분사도 thrust입니다(thrusted 아님).

entries.sense_en: any object that happens to be near enough to grab

synonyms.nuance: Near and easy to reach, without the idea of grabbing at random.
Informal: close by and ready to use.
synonyms.example: Do you have a pen handy?

entries.sense_en: his lips twisted and moved as he tried not to cry

synonyms.nuance: Shake slightly from fear or emotion.
A small, fast shaking, often of lips or voice.

entries.tip_ko: work는 여기서 '일하다'가 아니라 감정 때문에 입·얼굴이 '씰룩이다'라는 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: (a Russian saying) beat someone very hard

synonyms.nuance: Beat so badly that bruises appear.
synonyms.example: They beat him black and blue.

synonyms.word: within an inch of one's life
synonyms.nuance: Very severely, almost to death.
synonyms.example: He was beaten within an inch of his life.

entries.tip_ko: 러시아어 관용구를 그대로 옮긴 것이라 영어 원어민에게도 낯섭니다.

entries.sense_en: a man who manages a large estate for its owner

synonyms.nuance: The chief servant inside a house, not the manager of land.
Modern general word.
British: a man who ran a farm estate for its owner; today mostly a court officer.

entries.tip_ko: 오늘날 steward는 비행기·배의 남자 승무원을 떠올리기 쉽습니다.

entries.sense_en: here a sincere plea: please, in the name of Christ

synonyms.nuance: The plain word for asking.
Also once a real plea; today mostly an angry exclamation.

entries.tip_ko: 현대 영어에서 For Christ's sake!는 짜증 섞인 욕설에 가깝습니다. 여기서는 옛 뜻 그대로 간절한 부탁입니다.

entries.sense_en: wanting to hurt or annoy; here, dogs that bite

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for unkind.
synonyms.example: Don't be mean to your sister.

synonyms.nuance: Violent and dangerous; used for dogs that attack.
Formal: deliberately intending harm.

entries.sense_en: I would not be surprised if; it is quite likely that
entries.sense_ko: ~라 해도 놀랍지 않을 거예요, 아마 ~일 거예요

synonyms.nuance: Informal and confident.
Neutral adverb.

entries.tip_ko: wonder를 '궁금하다'로 읽으면 틀립니다. 여기서는 '놀라다'의 옛 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: covered with a thin layer of gold or gold paint

synonyms.nuance: Gold in color, or made of gold; the most general word.
Same meaning; gilded is also used figuratively.

entries.tip_ko: guilt(죄책감)와 발음이 같습니다: /ɡɪlt/.

entries.sense_en: shaking slightly because of strong feeling

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word, also for hands, buildings and plans.
Very close; tremulous is more literary.
Used almost only for a voice that shakes.

entries.sense_en: laughed happily in a noisy, snorting way

synonyms.nuance: Quieter and calmer.
A loud, rough laugh.

entries.tip_ko: 루이스 캐럴이 chuckle과 snort를 합쳐 만든 단어입니다.

entries.sense_en: stop himself from doing

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday phrase.
synonyms.example: I couldn't stop myself from laughing.

synonyms.nuance: Used with -ing when something is tempting.
Formal; mostly for voting, drinking or food.

entries.tip_ko: 'Please refrain from smoking'처럼 공공 안내문에서 자주 봅니다.

entries.sense_en: began working busily

synonyms.nuance: Begin to give serious attention to a task.
Plain everyday verb.

entries.sense_en: sweets and nice things to eat

synonyms.nuance: Something special given for pleasure, often to children or pets.
British for candy.

entries.sense_en: an old dance for four couples standing in a square

synonyms.nuance: The American folk dance that grew from it.
A couple dance in three-beat time, not a group dance.

entries.sense_en: hits and treats me roughly, again and again

synonyms.nuance: Attack and hurt someone badly, usually once.
synonyms.example: He was beaten up after school.

synonyms.nuance: Order someone about and bully them; not always physical.
synonyms.example: Don't let them push you around.

entries.sense_en: very unhappy and miserable

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; wretched is stronger and more literary.
Makes others feel pity; can also mean contemptible.
Literary, full of sorrow; today often means 'very bad'.

entries.tip_ko: 10문단의 wretched brat에서는 '빌어먹을, 지긋지긋한'이라는 경멸의 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: a Russian coin, one hundredth of a rouble

synonyms.nuance: The English coin of very small value; the natural comparison.
The main Russian money unit, 100 kopecks.

entries.sense_en: a long, heavy overcoat

synonyms.nuance: The normal modern word.
A lighter overcoat.

entries.sense_en: just as he was, without changing or adding clothes
entries.sense_ko: (옷도 챙겨 입지 않고) 있던 차림 그대로

synonyms.nuance: Used for goods sold in their present condition.
synonyms.example: The car is sold as is.

synonyms.nuance: Informal: without preparation.

entries.sense_en: calmed and gently sent to sleep

synonyms.nuance: Calm pain or worry, not necessarily into sleep.
Move a baby gently from side to side to calm it.
synonyms.example: He rocked the baby to sleep.

entries.tip_ko: lullaby(자장가)와 같은 뿌리입니다.
